question: The number of Indian athletes who participated in the Tokyo Paralympics 2020 was _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**54**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **54** Indian athletes participated in the Tokyo Paralympics 2020.
 
• This was the largest contingent India has sent to any Paralympics.
 
• India competed in nine different sports, including archery, athletics, badminton, shooting, swimming, powerlifting, table tennis, and taekwondo.
 
• The athletes delivered India's best ever performance at the Paralympics, winning a total of 19 medals (5 gold, 8 silver, and 6 bronze).
 
• India's previous best medal tally was 4 medals at the Rio 2016 Paralympics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Tokyo Paralympics 2020 were held from 24th August to 5th September 2021, having been postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The event featured 539 events across 22 sports, with over 4,500 athletes from around the world participating.
 
• India made its Paralympic debut in 1968 and has since participated in every edition except for the 1976 Games.
 
• The Paralympic Games are a major international multi-sport event for athletes with disabilities, organized by the International Paralympic Committee.
